rows.angle: There is no $10 trillion silver tsunami
rows.format: Text · Threshold (contrarian slot) · personas P1 P3 · pillar Dead Deal Economics / credibility play · lands as DealSource connections check the feed
rows.carries: ~2.9M employer firms with owners 55+ (Project Equity) — the defensible floor; Gallup: 67% of owners 55+ intend to close outright or don't know what they'll do; one succession report warns of 30–50% double-counting across its own inputs. The $10T / twelve-million-business headline is DEBUNKED (bundles non-employer sole proprietorships), never claimed. The tailwind is real, the TAM is marketing, the edge is skepticism.
